# satisfactory_buildable_class (Data Source)

Footprint of a buildable class, read from the game without placing anything. Use it to size layouts instead of guessing spacing; see the grid-2d module.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `class` (String) Buildable class name, e.g. Build_Foundation_8x1_01_C.

### Read-Only

- `max` (Attributes) Highest corner of the clearance footprint. Null if the class declares no clearance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max))
- `min` (Attributes) Lowest corner of the clearance footprint, in centimetres relative to the buildable's origin. Null if the class declares no clearance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--min))
- `size` (Attributes) Footprint extent (max - min), in centimetres. Null if the class declares no clearance. This is what you want for spacing: `size.x` is how much room a tile needs along X. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--size))

<a id="nestedatt--max"></a>
### Nested Schema for `max`

Read-Only:

- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)
- `z` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--min"></a>
### Nested Schema for `min`

Read-Only:

- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)
- `z` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--size"></a>
### Nested Schema for `size`

Read-Only:

- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)
- `z` (Number)
